profiles.objective: Sound evidence plus verified priority, importance, and broad-reader relevance.
profiles.wrong_optimization: Do not manufacture breadth or significance with rhetoric.

profiles.objective: Sound, complete work that makes a meaningful field-specific contribution.
profiles.wrong_optimization: Do not imitate general-science breadth at the cost of technical precision.

profiles.objective: A rigorous, ethical, intelligible contribution to the scholarly record.
profiles.wrong_optimization: Do not invent impact, novelty, or breadth gates.

profiles.objective: Valid evidence plus target-specific clinical, public-health, or policy priority.
profiles.wrong_optimization: Do not equate statistical significance with clinical importance.

profiles.objective: Report significance and strength of evidence separately without inventing a conventional post-review acceptance gate.
profiles.wrong_optimization: Do not collapse evidence strength and significance into one score.

profiles.objective: Select a sufficiently complete current submission under venue and deadline constraints.
profiles.wrong_optimization: Do not assume an indefinite major-revision path exists.

profiles.objective: Preserve scientific validity and reader clarity while exact venue policy remains unresolved.
profiles.wrong_optimization: Do not attribute generic defaults to the unresolved journal.
